annotations.title: Brazilian CNPJ dossier with deterministic B2B risk score

description: Resolves a Brazilian company CNPJ into a full dossier from the public Receita Federal base: legal and trade name, registration status, tenure, share capital, CNAE activity, Simples/MEI flags, head-office address, cap table summary, and a deterministic B2B risk score with an explicit transact / review / refuse recommendation. Use it for KYB onboarding, supplier approval, credit triage and enriching a lead before invoicing. Do not use it merely to check whether a document's digits are well formed, which is cheaper and offline through br_validate_tax_id_checkdigits, and do not use it for a street address lookup from a postal code (use br_lookup_postal_address). Read-only and idempotent: nothing is written and the same CNPJ returns the same dossier until the public base changes. It queries an external public base, so a CNPJ that is mathematically valid but absent comes back as found:false with success:true, and invalid check digits come back as valid:false, never as an exception. Costs 0.01 USDC per call via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453) or a B2B X-API-Key; an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. The risk score is a rules-based triage signal computed at the edge, not a credit bureau rating.

aiSummary.description: When true (the default), appends aiExecutiveBrief, a Portuguese executive opinion on the counterparty. Set false to cut roughly 120 ms of latency; a deterministic one-line summary is produced either way whenever the company is found.

cnpj.description: Company CNPJ with 14 digits. Punctuation is accepted and stripped, so both '11.222.333/0001-81' and '11222333000181' work. The Mod-11 check digits are validated before any lookup is attempted.

name: br_lookup_company_dossier

aiExecutiveBrief.description: Portuguese executive opinion on transacting with this company. Omitted when the CNPJ was not found.

companyDossier.description: Corporate dossier assembled from the public Receita Federal CNPJ base. Always check valid and found before reading the remaining fields.

b2bRiskAssessment.description: Deterministic credit-and-compliance score computed at the edge from registration status, share capital and tenure. It is a rules-based triage signal, not a credit bureau score.

flags.description: Reason codes behind the score, for example ACTIVE_REGISTRATION, HIGH_SHARE_CAPITAL, LOW_SHARE_CAPITAL_UNDER_5K, ESTABLISHED_TENURE_OVER_5Y, NEWLY_CREATED_UNDER_1Y or INACTIVE_STATUS_<STATUS>.

recommendation.description: Action to take. A non-active registration always yields DO_NOT_TRANSACT_INACTIVE_CNPJ regardless of score.

riskScore.description: Risk from 5 (minimum) to 100 (critical). It starts at 20, adds 75 for a non-active registration, adds 15 for share capital under BRL 5,000, adds 20 for under one year of operation, and subtracts 10 each for share capital of BRL 100,000 or more and for five or more years of tenure.

riskTier.description: Band derived from riskScore: up to 25 is LOW_RISK, up to 60 is MEDIUM_RISK, above 60 is HIGH_RISK.

codigo.description: Numeric CNAE code of the main activity.

descricao.description: Text description of the main CNAE.

cnaesSecundariosCount.description: How many secondary CNAE codes the company registered.

cnpj.description: The 14 digits of the CNPJ, stripped of punctuation.

companyAgeYears.description: Whole years between the start year and the current year.

logradouro.description: Street type and name joined into one string.

error.description: Portuguese reason, present only when valid is false or found is false.

found.description: false when the CNPJ is mathematically valid but absent from the public base or the upstream lookup returned a non-200 status.

naturezaJuridica.description: Legal nature description, for example 'Sociedade Empresária Limitada'.

nomeFantasia.description: Trade name. Null when the company never registered one.

porte.description: Size bracket declared to Receita Federal, for example 'MICRO EMPRESA' or 'DEMAIS'.

quadroSocietarioCount.description: Total number of partners and officers in the registered cap table.

razaoSocial.description: Registered legal name of the company. Null when the base omits it.

regimeTributario.description: Tax-regime flags as recorded in the public base.

opcaoPeloMei.description: true when the company is registered as MEI.

opcaoPeloSimples.description: true when the company opted into Simples Nacional.

situacaoCadastral.description: Registration status in upper case, for example ATIVA, BAIXADA, SUSPENSA or INAPTA. Anything other than ATIVA drives the recommendation to DO_NOT_TRANSACT_INACTIVE_CNPJ.

sociosPrincipais.description: Up to the first five partners or officers.

faixaEtaria.description: Age bracket code published by Receita Federal.

valid.description: false when the CNPJ fails the Mod-11 check digits, in which case no lookup was attempted.

error.description: Stable machine-readable failure code, present only when the call itself was rejected. Common values: 'bad_request' (malformed JSON or no operation supplied), 'invalid_payment' / 'settlement_failed' (x402 verification or settlement refused, returned with HTTP 402), 'B2B_KEY_INVALID' and 'B2B_QUOTA_EXCEEDED' (B2B X-API-Key path), 'invalid_wafermap_signature' (marketplace HMAC path). A document that simply fails validation is NOT an error: the call returns success:true with valid:false inside the result block.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the failure, in Portuguese. Safe to log or surface to a human operator.

processingTimeMs.description: Edge processing time in milliseconds, excluding payment settlement. Mirrored in the X-Processing-Time-Ms response header.

success.description: true when the request was processed and paid for, independently of whether the CNPJ was found.

suggestedNextSteps.description: Chaining hints for autonomous agents: sibling paid APIs in the same suite that are commonly called right after this one. Purely advisory, never required.

endpoint.description: Absolute HTTPS endpoint of the suggested follow-up API.

priceUsdc.description: Price of the suggested follow-up call, in USDC.

tool.description: Tool name of the suggested follow-up API.

when.description: Condition under which the follow-up call is worth making.

title: Brazilian CNPJ dossier with deterministic B2B risk score
